name: Select Kiss
source:
You've been hired for a part-time job picking two people to lock in The Room Where You Must Kiss to Leave.
Select from a cast of six colorful characters, see how they bounce off one another, and imagine how things might unfold from there.

[From [url=https://vgperson.com/games/selectkiss.htm]vgperson[/url]]
